title: Canada Heliski + Resort Trip
subtitle: BC Powder Highway · Sunshine → Revelstoke → 3 heli days → Kicking Horse → Lake Louise
summary:
16 days, 3 riders (**Niko** — snowboard, **Nick Geelen**, **Stefan De Pauw** — skis), ~10.5–11 ski days across four big resorts **plus 3 heli days with Selkirk Tangiers**. The heli block (Feb 20–24, Coast Hillcrest) is the fixed anchor; everything else is a condition-chasing loop: Sunshine first (arrival-day resort, 2h from Calgary), then Revelstoke (biggest lift-served vertical in North America), the STHS heli, then Kicking Horse and Lake Louise.

**Booked**: flights BRU↔YYC (€1,005.81 pp, booking 9GMOL3) · STHS 3-Day Classic deposit paid ($2,964.15 CAD, 35%) · group locked at 3 · family room confirmed.

**Flex by design**: Day 3 is a *decide-on-the-hill* day, Day 10's KH afternoon is a skippable buffer, and Mar 1 flexes between a Lake Louise morning and a relaxed drive home. Heli down days (STHS averages 2–3/month) fall back to Revelstoke Mountain Resort.

practical.notes: **Logistics**: group of 3, one family room at the Hillcrest, 2 budget rooms shared 3 ways elsewhere. Calgary is UTC−7 (8h behind Brussels). eTA needed for Canada (online, ~$7 CAD). Flights have no direct option; snowboard/ski bag flies **free** as the 1×23kg checked bag. **Balance due Dec 10, 2026** — trip-cancellation insurance strongly recommended (deposit non-refundable, all payments retained <10 weeks out).

days.title: Banff Sunshine — full day
days.notes: Highest base in western Canada, ~925 cm snow/yr. Delirium Dive expert zone opened early Jan last season — no late-season risk front-loading it.

days.title: Flex — decide on the hill
days.notes: If Sunshine is riding well: extra half-day + afternoon drive to Revelstoke. Otherwise: morning drive + RMR afternoon leg-shakedown.

blocks.title: Flex day
blocks.description: **Decide on the hill** — the trip is built around a few of these. Both options are good.

blocks.title: Option B: Revelstoke Mountain Resort afternoon

days.title: Revelstoke Mountain Resort — full day
days.notes: 1,713 m vertical — biggest lift-served terrain in North America. ~400" snow/yr. North Bowl + glades.

blocks.title: Stay: Revelstoke (Northwinds by Basecamp, 2 rooms)
blocks.description: ~$90–140/room — cheapest solid option, ski shuttle, gear storage, town-adjacent.

blocks.title: Revelstoke full day — or rest day

days.title: STHS check-in — Coast Hillcrest
days.notes: Rest day + heli check-in. Orientation + dinner. **4 nights at Coast Hillcrest, all meals included.**

blocks.title: Selkirk Tangiers — 3-Day Classic, check-in
blocks.description: Deposit paid ($2,964.15 CAD, 35%). Family room (2 queen + 1 queen pullout). Balance due Dec 10, 2026.

blocks.title: Coast Hillcrest Hotel — 4 nights
blocks.description: Full breakfast, après snack, dinner in the Hillcrest Dining Room. Ski days Sun/Mon/Tue.

days.title: Heli day 1 — Selkirk Tangiers
days.notes: Bell 212, up to 10 guests + guide, unlimited metres included (9,000 m guaranteed). ACMG/IFMGA guides, Barryvox transceiver + training, gourmet mountain lunch. $5/day HeliCat donation.

blocks.title: Heli day 1
blocks.description: €5,880 pp incl. tax. If grounded (STHS averages 2–3 down days/month): RMR fallback or refunds — fairest refund policy in the industry.

days.title: Check-out → Golden, Kicking Horse afternoon
days.notes: Check-out after breakfast. Drive Revelstoke → Golden (134 km / 1h50) over Rogers Pass — check DriveBC + Avalanche Canada (avalanche-control closures possible). Afternoon at KH is a **buffer — skippable → 2+2**.

blocks.title: Drive Revelstoke → Golden (134 km)
blocks.description: Over Rogers Pass. Highway closures possible for avalanche control — check conditions before leaving.

blocks.title: Kicking Horse afternoon (buffer)
blocks.description: 1,315 m vertical (#4 in NA), champagne powder. Not on Ikon — day ticket ~$150–170 CAD.

blocks.title: Stay: Golden — Glacier Mountaineer Lodge (3 nights)
blocks.description: Ski-in/ski-out at the gondola, full kitchens — best for the KH block; splits well 3–4 ways in a suite.

days.title: Drive to Lake Louise + full day
days.notes: Drive Golden → Lake Louise (93 km / 1h20). 4,200 acres, 4 mountain faces, iconic scenery.

blocks.title: Stay: Lake Louise Inn (2 nights)
blocks.description: Closest mid-range to the resort, complimentary shuttle to the ski resort, ski tuning room.

blocks.title: Lake Louise full day
blocks.description: Back bowls / Summit Platter hike / World Cup downhill run.

days.title: Flex morning → fly home
days.notes: Either a Lake Louise morning (off the hill by ~11:30) or a relaxed drive with a Banff lunch. Then YYC → BRU.

blocks.title: Flex: LL morning or relaxed drive
